plan.objective: Google Business Profile API Integration (Agency Invitation Flow)

context.current_state: - Frontend GoogleConnectionModal asks users to approve an email invitation. - Supabase schema `users` already has `google_connected` and `google_location_id` fields (from 001_create_users.sql). - `run_poller.py` uses `mock_google.generate_fake_reviews()` instead of real API calls. - `admin.py` dashboard lacks endpoints to set `google_location_id` for users.
context.target_state: - Admin UI allows manual mapping of `google_location_id` to a `user_id` and toggles `google_connected`. - `google_api_service.py` connects to the real Google Business Profile API using a Master Refresh Token. - `run_poller.py` pulls real reviews for connected users and posts AI replies back to Google.

wave.name: Admin Google Mapping
wave.description: Provide the Admin Dashboard the tools to manually link users to their Google Location IDs after an invite is accepted.
wave.task: - Update `GET /users` route to also fetch `google_connected` and `google_location_id`. - Create new endpoint `PUT /users//google-config`. - Schema requires `google_connected` (boolean) and `google_location_id` (string). - Update user record in Supabase `users` table.

- Update the Users table columns to show a Google icon/status if `google_connected` is true. - Add an "Edit Google Config" action button for each user. - Build a small internal modal containing a text input for `Location ID` and a toggle for `Connected`. - Wire the submit button to the new PUT endpoint.

wave.name: Google API Core Service
wave.description: Create the HTTP service wrapper for the Google Business Profile API.
wave.task: - Add new required ENV keys for the Master OAuth connection: `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_MASTER_REFRESH_TOKEN`

- Implement `get_master_access_token()`: Makes a POST to `https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with the client credentials and refresh token. - Implement `fetch_recent_reviews(location_id, access_token)` -> returns standard list of review dicts. - Implement `reply_to_review(location_id, review_id, reply_text, access_token)`.

wave.name: Poller Engine Replacement
wave.description: Rip out the simulation code and plug the real API service into the heartbeat.
wave.task: - Update user fetch query to `eq("google_connected", True)`. - Remove `mock_google` imports. - Fetch a master access token using `get_master_access_token()`. - Loop over connected users, call `fetch_recent_reviews(user['google_location_id'], access_token)`. - Transform real Google review payload into our normalized db format.

- Add `post_to_google(reply_record, access_token)`. - Fetch the associated `location_id` by joining with the user table. - Call `reply_to_review(location_id, review_id, reply_text, access_token)`. - If 200 OK, update the `status` column in Supabase `replies` to "posted".
